# House of Zonshine

> House of Zonshine is the Los Angeles real estate practice of Julia Zonshine, a California-licensed real estate salesperson helping buyers and sellers make informed, personal decisions about home.

## Primary services

- [Relocating to Los Angeles](https://juliazonshine.com/relocating/): Local guidance for choosing where to live, evaluating homes from afar, and arriving with a clearer picture of daily life.
- [First-time home buying in Los Angeles](https://juliazonshine.com/first-time-buyers/): Clear guidance for first-time buyers preparing to buy a Los Angeles home.
- [Selling and buying your next home in Los Angeles](https://juliazonshine.com/move-up-buyers/): Support for homeowners who are selling, buying, and moving up or upgrading.
- [Downsizing in Los Angeles](https://juliazonshine.com/downsizing/): A considered approach for homeowners planning a smaller or simpler next chapter.

## Local resources

- [Neighborhood guides](https://juliazonshine.com/guides/): Practical perspective on Los Angeles neighborhoods and how they live day to day.
- [The Zonshine Edit](https://juliazonshine.com/favorites/): Julia's curated collection of distinctive homes across Los Angeles.
- [Blog](https://juliazonshine.com/blog/): Answer-first articles about buying, selling, insurance, market questions, and Los Angeles real estate.
- [Newsletter](https://juliazonshine.com/newsletter/): House stories, local perspective, and the people and places that make Los Angeles feel like home.
